dedupe_keys.name: world data centre for space weather australian bureau of meteorology space weather services

description: The World Data Centre section of the Bureau of Meteorology Space Weather Services site gives display tools and downloads for decades of Australian space weather observations. It covers magnetometer data, scaled hourly and autoscaled ionosonde data and monthly ionospheric medians for the Australian Space Weather Forecasting Centre station network, imaging riometer and riometer data from Casey, Davis, Macquarie Island and Mawson, cosmic ray data from Kingston and Mawson, spectrograph and solar radio data from Learmonth and Culgoora, and ionospheric scintillation and GPS data from stations such as Darwin, Macquarie Island, Niue, Vanimo and Weipa. A data catalogue documents formats, stations and log files, and third-party scanned Mundaring ionograms and magnetograms from Geoscience Australia are included. Access is free through a data server and web viewers; site content is Commonwealth copyright, with material marked by a Creative Commons logo licensed CC BY 3.0 Australia. Caveats: licensing differs between items, formats are station specific, and some series have gaps. It supports HF propagation, GNSS scintillation and geomagnetic induction studies for the Australian and Pacific region, including power grid GIC analysis; a related record is the GICy indices for Australia.
